frame_index.description: Frame position in the 24 fps output. Unique per keyframe and at most duration * 24.
frame_index.title: Frame Index

description:
FLUX 3 Max video generation.

Mode is determined by the inputs:
- Text-to-video: prompt only
- Image-to-video: prompt + image (optional end_image as the last frame)
- Keyframes-to-video: prompt + keyframes (cannot combine with image/end_image)

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video. For image modes, describe how the video unfolds from the image(s).
examples: A cinematic tracking shot through a misty forest at dawn, golden light filtering through ancient trees.
prompt.title: Prompt

image.description: First frame image for image-to-video (PNG, JPEG, or WebP).
image.title: Image

end_image.description: Optional last frame image (PNG, JPEG, or WebP). Requires image.
end_image.title: End Image

keyframes.description: Keyframe images pinned to frame positions (max 10, unique frame_index values). Cannot combine with image or end_image.
keyframes.title: Keyframes

resolution.description: Output resolution. 720p is cheaper and faster; 1080p for best quality.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio. auto uses 16:9 for text-to-video and follows the first image otherwise.

generate_audio.description: Generate a native soundtrack for the video.
generate_audio.title: Generate Audio

reasoning_level.description: How much effort to spend reasoning about the prompt. high is slower but follows the prompt more closely.
reasoning_level.title: Reasoning Level

title: AppInput
